manualReview.facts: Final four samples contain no observed invented product properties; claims remain limited to names, brand and finish/color.
manualReview.style: Paragraphs are preserved; repeated generic color-comparison advice can still need editorial removal.
manualReview.length: Final sparse inputs produced 221-258 characters, not forced 600-1200. Rich factual inputs were not live-tested in this round.
manualReview.limits: Conservative lexical guard can reject legitimate comparisons; it was not weakened. Manual review remains necessary.
manualReview.initialTrials: Prompt .4 padded sparse facts; .5 still made an unsupported comparison. Paid failures were metered, never applied. Hourly rate cap was observed without bypass.
